# FLX-3505: a sink could not finish writing a stream

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

The destination refused a write part-way: a disk filled up, a permission was missing, a file could not be renamed into place, or a read-back check found data that does not digest to the stream's outputDigest. A file sink stages every file under a hidden name and renames it into place only when the whole stream is written, and it removes what it staged when it fails, so no partial stream is left for a reader to mistake for a whole one. The run directory and its outputDigest are unaffected. Fix the cause the message names and run the command again: the same run writes the same files under the same names.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3505
```
